title: Statement of Limiting Conditions
content:
STATEMENT OF LIMITING CONDITIONS

 

The values set forth in this valuation are subject to the following limiting conditions:

  • That this valuation is premised on a proposed fifty (50) year lease hold interest.
  • The property has been valued as though free from liens and encumbrances than those contained in the deeds of records.
  • No liability is to be assumed for matters legal in nature nor is any opinion of title rendered by this report.
  • The capital value of the subject property is assumed to be on all cash basis. Financial arrangements would affect the price at which the property may be sold if placed on the open market.
  • The valuer by this report is not required to give testimony in court in reference to the appraised property unless arrangement for such contingency have been previously agreed upon.
  • The physical condition of the improvements and the soil characteristics were based on visual inspection only. No liability is assumed for the soundness of the structure since no engineering tests nor soil tests were made of the building and soil.
  • Sketches are accurate only for purposes of approximation.
  • Possession of any copy of this report does not carry with it the right to publication nor may it be used for any purpose by anyone except the addressee, their Bankers and Auditors, without the previous written consent of the Valuer, and, in any event, only may be revealed in its entirety.
  • This valuation is valid only as of the date stated herein. Values may change with market conditions.
  • The valuer has no present or prospective interest in the property that is the subject of this report.
  • The valuer's compensation is not contingent upon the reporting of a predetermined value or direction in value.
  • It is assumed that there is full compliance with all applicable government regulations unless otherwise stated.
  • The property is appraised assuming responsible ownership and competent management.
